candidate.user_submission: This child is 12 months old and has had cough or difficult breathing for 3 days. Breaths were counted for one full minute while the child was calm, and the respiratory rate was 40 breaths per minute. There is no chest indrawing, no stridor when calm, and no wheezing was observed. Recurrent wheeze is not present. The child is not convulsing now, has not had convulsions, is not lethargic or unconscious, and is able to drink and breastfeed. The child does not vomit everything. There is no diarrhoea, no ear problem, and no fever. A pulse oximeter was not available.
